Hi Alicia — thanks again for taking time earlier today. Good recap and aligned outcomes below so we stay tidy as you spin up the POC: 

• Goal: Validate Redwood inference on LiftGate’s fraud-detection scoring pipeline (latency under 150ms p50, stable throughput at 150 rps).
• Success criteria: sample throughput test + two example queries that match production token mix, cost estimate for steady-state.
• Owner(s): LiftGate infra (you) for network & whitelist, Redwood for model & infra.
• Next steps: 
  1) LiftGate to share a small sample payload and an allowlist CIDR for our test nodes (target by 11/3).
  2) Redwood to provision a trial instance and send POC checklist + calendar for an enablement session (I’ll schedule once we get the CIDR).

I’m attaching a lightweight POC checklist that guides the setup and the small KPI template you mentioned. If helpful I can schedule a 30-min lab session for your infra owner + engineer to walk through the allowlist step.

[Attachment: redwood-poc-checklist.pdf (PDF, 94KB)]
[Attachment: liftgate-kpi-template.xlsx (Excel, 12KB)]

Would 11/4 or 11/5 at 10am PT work for a quick enablement?

Thanks,
